description: Snapshot of the business's books for a period: income, expenses and profit (from the ledger), bank balances, money owed by customers and to suppliers, VAT position, bank lines still to reconcile and slips still missing. Defaults to this month so far. Read-only. Needs the user's GetAccountED sign-in (they are asked to sign in the first time).

business_id.description: Accounting practices only: which client's books (an id from accounting_list_my_businesses). Leave out to use the books chosen at sign-in.

from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (default: first day of this month)
